title: Gallows shadow — tethered creature rendering

tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Warwrit B023 static transparent combat roster sprite, a benign nonhuman tethered fantasy creature.
Input images: Image 1 unit-c-ink.png defines hand-drawn irregular ink, flat washes and upper-left lighting. Image 2 staraya-melnitsa.png defines rough weathered wood, coarse cord and muted palette only, no scene. Image 3 battle-ux-v3.png defines elevated three-quarter projection and small sprite readability. Image 4 night-mill-beast-concept-v2.png defines dark creature ink masses only, not its bear anatomy or eyes.
Subject: a thin, nonhuman fibre silhouette physically tethered by a taut ordinary coarse hemp cord around its waist/torso to a compact rough upright timber behind it. The creature STANDS on two narrow feet on the same level as the timber base. Show one narrow angular head with no facial detail, two slender bent arms and two complete slender legs; its structure consists of dense dark fibres like knotted weathered plant fibre, with credible connected joints. It leans a little forward toward screen upper-right, torso rotated upper-right, while the cord remains taut. The cord is visibly tied around its waist and tied firmly around the support, with the entire continuous rope path in view. Small simple rough timber support, full height and base within frame, no ground or scenery backdrop.
Safety and content constraints: no cord near the neck; no hanging loop; no suspended body; no corpse, skeleton, injury, violence, distressed person or execution scene. Entirely nonhuman standing creature with ordinary waist tether. No magic, smoke, glow, glowing eyes, symbols, weapons, ornaments or religious iconography.
Style: serious grounded fantasy, irregular dark ink outlines, internal hatching, matte flat washes and strong dark masses. Muted soot/slate/umber/ochre, subdued weathered timber and hemp, matching the references. Visible thin silhouette distinct from the wood. Fixed elevated three-quarter view, upper surfaces slightly visible, facing screen upper-right, light from upper-left.
Frame: one isolated complete creature, complete timber and all cord with comfortable transparent margins. True alpha transparency. No ground tile, terrain patch, painted contact shadow, pedestal, text, border, background, extra character or photorealistic/glossy rendering. Clear silhouette for human-equivalent 80px combat display.
